mapper.select: SELECT IPTEST.ITST_CODE, LEFT(CONVERT(NVARCHAR, IPTEST.ITST_DATE, 120), 10) AS ITST_DATE, LEFT(CONVERT(NVARCHAR, ORDERT.ORD_DATE, 120), 10) AS ORD_DATE, CORP.CORP_NAME, PRODUCT.PROD_NAME, PRODUCT.PROD_NO, PRODUCT.PROD_GYU, PRODUCT.PROD_JAI, IPTEST.ITST_WP, IPTEST.ITST_P, IPTEST.ITST_POOR, ITST_11N, ITST_12N FROM IPTEST INNER JOIN ORDERT ON IPTEST.ORD_CODE = ORDERT.ORD_CODE INNER JOIN PRODUCT ON ORDERT.PROD_CODE = PRODUCT.PROD_CODE INNER JOIN CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE WHERE IPTEST.ITST_DATE BETWEEN #{sdate} AND #{edate} ORDER BY IPTEST.ITST_DATE, CORP.CORP_NAME, PRODUCT.PROD_NAME, PRODUCT.PROD_NO

SELECT IPTEST.*, LEFT(CONVERT(NVARCHAR, IPTEST.ITST_DATE, 120), 10) AS ITST_DATE1, ORDERT.ORD_DATE, CORP.CORP_NAME, PRODUCT.PROD_NAME, PRODUCT.PROD_NO, PRODUCT.PROD_JAI, ORDERT.ORD_SU, ORDERT.ORD_LOT, IPTEST.ITST_SU, IPTEST.ITST_TEST, IPTEST.ITST_POOR, IPTEST.ITST_11N, IPTEST.ITST_12N, IPTEST.ITST_111, IPTEST.ITST_112, IPTEST.ITST_113, IPTEST.ITST_114, IPTEST.ITST_121, IPTEST.ITST_122, IPTEST.ITST_123, IPTEST.ITST_124, IPTEST.ITST_BIGO, IPTEST.ITST_SU FROM IPTEST INNER JOIN ORDERT ON IPTEST.ORD_CODE = ORDERT.ORD_CODE INNER JOIN PRODUCT ON ORDERT.PROD_CODE = PRODUCT.PROD_CODE INNER JOIN CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE WHERE IPTEST.ITST_CODE = #{itst_code}
